verses.en: Verily I say unto you, my friends, behold, I will give unto you a revelation and commandment, that you may know how to act in the discharge of your duties concerning the salvation and redemption of your brethren, who have been scattered on the land of Zion;
verses.sm: E Moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, a’u uo e, faauta, o le a Ou tuu atu ia te outou se faaaliga ma se poloaiga, ina ia outou iloa le ala e amio ai i le faataunuuina o o outou tiute e faatatau i le faaolataga ma le togiolaina o o outou uso, o e ua faataapeapeina i luga o le laueleele o Siona;

verses.en: Being driven and smitten by the hands of mine enemies, on whom I will pour out my wrath without measure in mine own time.
verses.sm: Aua ua tulia ma taia i lima o o’u fili, o e o le a Ou sasaa atu i ai i luga lo’u ita e lē mafuatia i lo’u lava taimi e tatau ai.

w.en: in my in mine own time

verses.en: For I have suffered them thus far, that they might fill up the measure of their iniquities, that their cup might be full;
verses.sm: Aua ua faapea ona Ou tuu atu ia te i latou e oo mai i lenei taimi, ina ia latou faatumuina le fuataga o a latou amioletonu, ina ia tumu la latou ipu;

verses.en: And that those who call themselves after my name might be chastened for a little season with a sore and grievous chastisement, because they did not hearken altogether unto the precepts and commandments which I gave unto them.
verses.sm: Ma ina ia mafai ona aoaiina i latou o e ua ta’ua i latou lava i lo’u igoa mo se vaitau itiiti i se aoaiga tiga ma mamafa, aua sa latou lē faalogo atoa mai i faatonuga ma poloaiga na Ou tuu atu ia te i latou.

verses.en: But verily I say unto you, that I have decreed a decree which my people shall realize, inasmuch as they hearken from this very hour unto the counsel which I, the Lord their God, shall give unto them.
verses.sm: Peitai e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ua Ou folafolaina se folafolaga, lea o le a maua e lo’u nuu, pe afai latou te faalogo mai i lenei lava itula i le fautuaga o le a tuu atu e A’u, o le Alii lo latou Atua, ia te i latou.

verses.en: Behold they shall, for I have decreed it, begin to prevail against mine enemies from this very hour.
verses.sm: Faauta, ona ua Ou folafolaina, o le a amata atu mai lenei lava itula ona latou manumalo e faasaga i o’u fili.

verses.en: And by hearkening to observe all the words which I, the Lord their God, shall speak unto them, they shall never cease to prevail until the kingdoms of the world are subdued under my feet, and the earth is given unto the saints, to possess it forever and ever.
verses.sm: Ma o le faaeteete e tausi i upu uma o le a tautala atu ai A’u, o le Alii lo latou Atua, ia te i latou, o le a lē taofia ai lava ona latou manumalo seia oo ina faatoilaloina malo o le lalolagi i lalo o o’u vae, ma tuuina atu le lalolagi i le au paia, e fai mo i latou e faavavau ma faavavau lava.

verses.en: But inasmuch as they keep not my commandments, and hearken not to observe all my words, the kingdoms of the world shall prevail against them.
verses.sm: Ae afai latou te lē tausia a’u poloaiga, ma lē faalogo e tausi i a’u upu uma, o le a manumalo malo o le lalolagi e faasaga ia te i latou.

verses.en: For they were set to be a light unto the world, and to be the saviors of men;
verses.sm: Aua sa faatutu mai i latou e avea ma malamalama i le lalolagi, ma avea ma faaola o tagata;

verses.en: And inasmuch as they are not the saviors of men, they are as salt that has lost its savor, and is thenceforth good for nothing but to be cast out and trodden under foot of men.
verses.sm: Ma e tusa ai ma le lē avea o i latou ma faaola o tagata, e pei i latou o le masima ua magalo, ma e leai se mea e toe aoga i ai mai lena taimi ma le agai i luma, ae nao le lafoaiina i fafo ma solia i lalo o vae o tagata.

verses.en: But verily I say unto you, I have decreed that your brethren which have been scattered shall return to the lands of their inheritances, and shall build up the waste places of Zion.
verses.sm: Peitai e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ua Ou folafola o le a toe foi mai o outou uso ua faataapeapeina i laueleele o o latou tofi, ma o le a latou atia’e nofoaga tuufua o Siona.

verses.en: For after much tribulation, as I have said unto you in a former commandment, cometh the blessing.
verses.sm: Aua a mavae puapuaga e tele, e pei ona Ou fai atu ai ia te outou i se poloaiga ua mavae, ona oo mai lea o le faamanuiaga.

verses.en: Behold, this is the blessing which I have promised after your tribulations, and the tribulations of your brethren—your redemption, and the redemption of your brethren, even their restoration to the land of Zion, to be established, no more to be thrown down.
verses.sm: Faauta, o le faamanuiaga lenei na Ou folafola atu pe a mavae o outou puapuaga, ma puapuaga o o outou uso— o le laveaiina lea o outou, ma le laveaiina o o outou uso, o lo latou toefuataiga lava lea i le laueleele o Siona, e faamautuina, e lē toe lafoina i lalo.

verses.en: Nevertheless, if they pollute their inheritances they shall be thrown down; for I will not spare them if they pollute their inheritances.
verses.sm: Ae ui i lea, afai latou te faaeleelea o latou tofi, o le a lafoina i latou i lalo; ona o le a Ou lē faasaoina i latou pe afai latou te faaeleelea o latou tofi.

verses.en: Behold, I say unto you, the redemption of Zion must needs come by power;
verses.sm: Faauta, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o le laveaiina o Siona e ao ina oo mai e ala i le mana;

verses.en: Therefore, I will raise up unto my people a man, who shall lead them like as Moses led the children of Israel.
verses.sm: O lea, o le a Ou faatuina a’e i lo’u nuu se tagata, o lē o le a taitaia i latou e pei ona sa taitaia e Mose le fanauga a Isaraelu.

verses.en: For ye are the children of Israel, and of the seed of Abraham, and ye must needs be led out of bondage by power, and with a stretched-out arm.
verses.sm: Aua o outou o fanau a Isaraelu, ma o le fanau a Aperaamo, ma e ao ina taitai ese outou mai le nofo pologa i le mana, ma le aao faaloaloa atu.

verses.en: And as your fathers were led at the first, even so shall the redemption of Zion be.
verses.sm: Ma e pei ona sa taitaiina muamua o outou tamā, o le a faapea lava le laveaiina o Siona.

verses.en: Therefore, let not your hearts faint, for I say not unto you as I said unto your fathers: Mine angel shall go up before you, but not my presence.
verses.sm: O lea, ia lē tuu atu o outou loto ia faavaivai, aua Ou te lē fai atu ia te outou e pei ona sa Ou fai atu i o outou tamā: O le a alu atu la’u agelu e muamua atu ia te outou, ae lē o lo’u mamalu.

verses.en: But I say unto you: Mine angels shall go up before you, and also my presence, and in time ye shall possess the goodly land.
verses.sm: Ae Ou te fai atu ia te outou: O le a o atu a’u agelu e muamua atu ia te outou, ma lo’u mamalu foi, ma o le a outou maua le laueleele lelei i se taimi.

verses.en: Verily, verily I say unto you, that my servant Joseph Smith, Jun., is the man to whom I likened the servant to whom the Lord of the vineyard spake in the parable which I have given unto you.
verses.sm: E moni, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o la’u auauna o Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti, o le tagata lea ua Ou faatusa i ai le auauna o lē na fetalai atu i ai le Alii o le tovine i le faataoto lea na Ou tuu atu ia te outou.

verses.en: Therefore let my servant Joseph Smith, Jun., say unto the strength of my house, my young men and the middle aged—Gather yourselves together unto the land of Zion, upon the land which I have bought with money that has been consecrated unto me.
verses.sm: O lea ia tuu atu ai i la’u auauna o Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti, e fai atu i le malosi o lo’u fale, o a’u alii talavou ma faamatuā-tagata— Ia outou faapotopoto faatasi outou lava i le laueleele o Siona, i luga o le laueleele lea na Ou faatau mai i tupe na faapaia mai ia te a’u.

verses.en: And let all the churches send up wise men with their moneys, and purchase lands even as I have commanded them.
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu atu i aulotu uma e auina atu i luga tagata atamamai ma a latou tupe, ma faatau mai laueleele e pei ona sa Ou poloaiina ai i latou.

verses.en: And inasmuch as mine enemies come against you to drive you from my goodly land, which I have consecrated to be the land of Zion, even from your own lands after these testimonies, which ye have brought before me against them, ye shall curse them;
verses.sm: Ma e tusa ai ma le o mai o o’u fili e faasaga mai ia te outou e tutuli ese outou mai lo’u laueleele lelei, lea ua Ou faapaiaina e avea ma laueleele o Siona, e mai i o outou lava laueleele ina ua mavae ia molimau, ia na outou aumai i o’u luma e faasaga ia te i latou, ia outou fetuu i latou;

verses.en: And whomsoever ye curse, I will curse, and ye shall avenge me of mine enemies.
verses.sm: Ma o soo se tasi tou te fetuu, o le a Ou fetuuina, ma ia outou taui ma sui atu i o’u fili.

verses.en: And my presence shall be with you even in avenging me of mine enemies, unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me.
verses.sm: Ma o le a faatasi lo’u mamalu ma outou i le taui ma sui atu i o’u fili, e oo atu i le tupulaga e tolu ma le fa o i latou o e e inoino mai ia te a’u.

verses.en: Let no man be afraid to lay down his life for my sake; for whoso layeth down his life for my sake shall find it again.
verses.sm: Ia leai se tagata e fefe e tuu atu lona ola ona o a’u; aua o lē e tuu atu lona ola ona o a’u o le a toe maua e ia.

verses.en: And whoso is not willing to lay down his life for my sake is not my disciple.
verses.sm: Ma ’ai se e lē loto e tuu atu lona ola ona o a’u e lē o so’u soo o ia.

verses.en: It is my will that my servant Sidney Rigdon shall lift up his voice in the congregations in the eastern countries, in preparing the churches to keep the commandments which I have given unto them concerning the restoration and redemption of Zion.
verses.sm: O lo’u loto ia siitia a’e e la’u auauna o Sini Rikitone lona leo i faapotopotoga i itu-laueleele i sasa’e, i le sauniuniga o aulotu e tausi i poloaiga ua Ou tuuina atu ia te i latou e faatatau i le toefuataiga ma le laveaiina o Siona.

verses.en: It is my will that my servant Parley P. Pratt and my servant Lyman Wight should not return to the land of their brethren, until they have obtained companies to go up unto the land of Zion, by tens, or by twenties, or by fifties, or by an hundred, until they have obtained to the number of five hundred of the strength of my house.
verses.sm: O lo’u loto o la’u auauna o Parley P. Pratt ma la’u auauna o Laimani Uaite e lē tatau ona foi atu i le laueleele o o la uso, seia la maua ni vaega o tagata e o atu i luga i le laueleele o Siona, e taitoasefulu, pe taitoaluasefulu, pe taitoalimagafulu, pe taitoaselau, seia la maua le aofai e lima selau o le malosi o lo’u fale.

verses.en: Behold this is my will; ask and ye shall receive; but men do not always do my will.
verses.sm: Faauta o lo’u loto lea; ole mai ma o le a outou maua ai; peitai e lē faia e tagata lo’u loto i taimi uma.

verses.en: Therefore, if you cannot obtain five hundred, seek diligently that peradventure you may obtain three hundred.
verses.sm: O lea, afai e lē mafai ona outou maua le lima selau, ia saili ma le filiga atonu e mafai ona outou maua se tolu selau.

verses.en: And if ye cannot obtain three hundred, seek diligently that peradventure ye may obtain one hundred.
verses.sm: Ma afai e lē mafai ona outou maua le tolu selau, ia saili ma le filiga atonu e mafai ona outou maua se tasi selau.

verses.en: But verily I say unto you, a commandment I give unto you, that ye shall not go up unto the land of Zion until you have obtained a hundred of the strength of my house, to go up with you unto the land of Zion.
verses.sm: Peitai e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, Ou te tuu atu ia te outou se poloaiga, ia outou lē o a’e i le laueleele o Siona seia outou maua se toaselau o le malosi o lo’u fale, e o atu faatasi ma outou i le laueleele o Siona.

w.en: the go up to the land

verses.en: Therefore, as I said unto you, ask and ye shall receive; pray earnestly that peradventure my servant Joseph Smith, Jun., may go with you, and preside in the midst of my people, and organize my kingdom upon the consecrated land, and establish the children of Zion upon the laws and commandments which have been and which shall be given unto you.
verses.sm: O lea, e pei ona Ou fai atu ia te outou, ole mai ma o le a outou maua ai, tatalo ma le faatauanau atonu e mafai e la’u auauna o Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti, ona alu atu faatasi ma outou, ma pulefaamalumalu i totonu o lo’u nuu, ma faatulaga lo’u malo i luga o le laueleele ua faapaiaina, ma faamautu fanau a Siona i luga o tulafono ma poloaiga ua tuu atu ma o le a tuuina atu ia te outou.

verses.en: All victory and glory is brought to pass unto you through your diligence, faithfulness, and prayers of faith.
verses.sm: O manumalo ma le mamalu uma e aumai ia te outou e ala i lo outou filiga, faamaoni, ma tatalo o le faatuatua.

verses.en: Let my servant Parley P. Pratt journey with my servant Joseph Smith, Jun.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o Parley P. Pratt e malaga atu faatasi ma la’u auauna o Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti.

verses.en: Let my servant Lyman Wight journey with my servant Sidney Rigdon.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o Lyman Wight e malaga atu faatasi ma la’u auauna o Sini Rikitone.

verses.en: Let my servant Hyrum Smith journey with my servant Frederick G. Williams.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o Ailama Samita e malaga atu faatasi ma la’u auauna o Frederick G. Williams.

verses.en: Let my servant Orson Hyde journey with my servant Orson Pratt, whithersoever my servant Joseph Smith, Jun., shall counsel them, in obtaining the fulfilment of these commandments which I have given unto you, and leave the residue in my hands. Even so. Amen.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o Orson Hyde e malaga atu faatasi ma la’u auauna o Orson Pratt, i soo se mea e fautuaina ai i laua e la’u auauna o Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti, i le mauaina o le faataunuuga o nei poloaiga ua Ou tuuina atu ia te outou, ma taatia mai mea o totoe i o’u lima. E faapea lava. Amene.
